Fellow class-dropper Star Anthem is feared most, while Brave Mission and Power Fizz are shaping up nicely.

Down Royal runner-up College Causeway should also be competitive for trainer John McConnell.

selections.comment: A consistent mare, who has been placed in four of her five previous runs, DERRYVILLE can register a first win. The Sam Curling-trained five-year-old finished runner-up to the subsequent Grade 1 Cheltenham bumper winner at Punchestown in December. There was plenty to take from her recent reappearance when a staying on fifth at the Fairyhouse Easter Festival. Sure to be all the sharper following that comeback, the Affinisea mare should be hard to beat. With Emmet Mullins proving a real force in bumpers of late, Tricksofthetrade has to be respected on just her second start under rules. A former point-to-point runner-up, she will appreciate this stiff test. Broomfield Aderra also looks a leading contender under Josh Halford.

The form of that race looks reasonable, with the third gaining second in another class 2. Sioux Perfect was sent off favourite for her debut when only 5th, but the winner, second and sixth have all won since. She was green that day and is sure to come on. Society Kiss is a newcomer who can go well for the strong Beckett stable.

selections.comment: A few of these have some form already in the book, although it isn't necessarily the strongest. There are some very well bred newcomers here today and the Gosdens seem to have a very strong hand. They run three and top of that list looks to be Good Old Days. She is a full-sister to the top class Nations Pride, who won across the globe at 8-10f. The dam was also a Listed winner over 9f. Lots to like. El Budoor is another of their newcomers and is also well bred by Kingman and out of the very smart Enbihaar, who was a winner from 10-16.5f. Cape Flora rounds off the Gosden's three and is the one with a run already. She was green that day and is open to plenty of improvement. SPIRITED STYLE starts for the top Appleby stable and again has a lovely pedigree and is the one selected to make a winning debut. Wonder Star also deserves a mention as one who should come on for her debut. Watch the market.

Vocal Legend warrants consideration as well.

The addition of a tongue tie could help him see the race out better and his opening mark looks on the generous side. The sole real danger looks to be the unexposed Jollie Cosmos who ran well over an inadequate distance over hurdles last time rallying gamely. Dee's Getaway is yet to fire over fences but has been given gentle rides and is a potential improver should the handbrake be lowered.
